description: This file contains functions and scripts for managing Broadcom wireless drivers in OpenWrt, including scanning, enabling, disabling, and detecting Broadcom wireless devices.

methods.name: scan_broadcom
methods.description: Scans for Broadcom wireless devices and configures wireless interfaces accordingly.

methods.name: disable_broadcom
methods.description: Disables a Broadcom wireless device, bringing interfaces down and removing driver configurations.

methods.name: enable_broadcom
methods.description: Enables and configures a Broadcom wireless device with specified parameters.

methods.name: detect_broadcom
methods.description: Detects Broadcom wireless devices present in the system and initializes their configuration.
